answer_1.quote: Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) aims to correct grammatical errors in the given sentence ... We evaluated on the CoNLL 2014 test set and BEA 2019 test set, as well as Chinese GEC datasets (NLPCC 2018, FCGEC, NaCGEC).

answer_2.quote: We evaluated on the CoNLL 2014 test set with M2 scorer and the BEA 2019 test set, and reported precision (P), recall (R) and F0.5 scores following common practices.
